## Framing

VG06 jointly models understood and spoken vocabulary in typically developing children over approximately 9–30 months. It uses the same production-ratio reparameterisation as [VG05](vg05.qmd) and the same Wordbank 10 % sampling as [VG03](vg03.qmd)/[VG04](vg04.qmd). See the [methods chapter](methods.qmd) for the shared specification.

VG06 is the TD reference for all matched-age and matched-comprehension comparisons in this report. Where the model comparison chapter quotes a TD production ratio at a given understood-word level, the number comes from VG06.

## Model specification

VG06 instantiates the joint model with:

- `n_trials = 690`
- slope anchors $(12, 26)$ months
- 10 % Wordbank sample (`random_seed = 47`)
- 1 655 observations × 2 outcomes = 3 310 contributions to the likelihood

### Slope-anchor priors

For the understood trajectory:

$$p_{12}^U \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1, 20), \qquad p_{26}^U \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1.5, 1.1).$$

For the production ratio, family-wide defaults are used:

$$p_{12}^q \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1, 1.5), \qquad p_{26}^q \sim \mathrm{Beta}(2, 1.2).$$

## Results

### Diagnostics

VG06 sampled at rep quality: r̂_max = 1.001, ESS_bulk_min = 12 147 across reported parameters (ESS_bulk_max = 50 928), **one** divergence (the only divergence across the entire 12 May rep run), 1 h 02 m 57 s wall time. elpd_loo = −18 770.7 (n = 3 310 observations).

The single divergence in a model with otherwise excellent diagnostics (r̂_max = 1.001, ESS_bulk_min > 12 000) does not change any reported quantity. A pattern of divergences would warrant a reparameterisation (typically non-centring the production-ratio GP) or a higher `target_accept`, but a single divergence is consistent with sampler noise.

### Population trajectory

Median values, with 90% credible intervals for the typical trajectory:

| Age (months) | Understood (median) | Spoken (median) | Production ratio (q) |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 9 | 49 [41–57] | 3.5 [2.6–4.4] | 0.05 |
| 12 | 83 [76–90] | 12 [10–13] | 0.14 |
| 18 | 134 [126–143] | 86 [81–91] | 0.63 |
| 24 | 276 [263–290] | 269 [257–281] | 0.95 |
| 30 | 430 [404–456] | 441 [417–465] | 0.99 |

The TD production ratio reaches 50% by ~18 months and exceeds 95% by 24 months — a quick and near-complete closure of the comprehension–production gap.

### Matched-comprehension reference

The matched-comprehension TD reference uses VG06 to compute the comprehension level at which the production ratio crosses each of {0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 0.90}. From `output/comparisons/ds_td_q_crossings.csv`:

| Production ratio | Words understood (TD, VG06) |
| ---: | ---: |
| 0.25 | 100 |
| 0.50 | 121 |
| 0.75 | 156 |
| 0.90 | 225 |

These are the comparison values against which the DS production curve under VG09 sits at roughly 1.85× the comprehension threshold (see the [matched-comprehension section of the model comparison chapter](model-comparison.qmd#sec-matched-comprehension)).

The full posterior summary tables and figures are in `output/models/VG06-age-understood-spoken-td/`. The rendered per-model report is `output/models/VG06-age-understood-spoken-td/index.html`.

## Status of VG06 in the family

VG06 is the headline TD joint model. It is the source of every quoted TD number in the [model comparison chapter](model-comparison.qmd) and the reference against which the DS joint models VG05, VG07, VG08 and VG09 are compared at matched comprehension.

The natural symmetric extension — adding study-level and subject-level random intercepts to VG06 as VG07/VG08/VG09 do for the DS data — has not been fitted. Wordbank aggregates many studies and many subjects, so the compositional argument that motivated random intercepts in DS would apply here too. The empirical question of whether a TD random-intercept model materially changes the matched-comprehension reference is open and listed as future work in the [discussion chapter](discussion.qmd).

## Limitations

- **No random-intercept structure.** As above, this is the natural symmetric extension. The current VG06 estimates are quoted on the understanding that the matched-comprehension reference is reasonably stable but not formally checked against a random-intercept TD model.
- **Wordbank-specific limitations.** Inherited from VG03 and VG04: the 10% subsample, the instrument and population mix, and the age-range mismatch with the DS data.
